# Jakten på trygga hamnar – har hälsovård mer att ge?

**Feed**: borslunch  
**Published**: 2026-11-11  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Börslunch (EFN) episode on the healthcare sector with fund managers from Arctic and Rimman Partners. The guests are cautiously positive. Money is rotating into big pharma (led by Eli Lilly), the US midterms may favour wider insurance coverage and a return of early-stage research funding, and medtech is seen as positioned for a comeback next year. They stress selectivity, warn about crowding (Moderna) and about underfunded Swedish biotechs (BioInvent), and name Revolution Medicines as a top pick after one of the strongest drug launches ever.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 RVMD — Revolution Medicines | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Record pancreatic cancer launch (~$197m in 5 weeks), survival doubled, platform can expand; guests expect the trend to continue.

#### Reasoning

Guest (Rimman/Arctic manager) calls it one of the best launches in history. Median survival went from 7 to 13 months. The drug is in a protected Medicare Part D class, with good prescription trends and insurance coverage. Expansion into lung cancer and earlier treatment lines gives more upside, although the stock did not move on the September report, so part of this may already be priced in.

#### Sell Triggers

- if prescription trends or insurance coverage weaken
- if expansion trials in lung cancer or earlier lines fail
- if US drug-pricing reforms hit oncology drugs

> *"Vi tror att den trenden för Revolution Medicine kan fortsätta."*

---

### 🟢 LLY — Eli Lilly | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Called the sector's shining star with strong growth; keeps rising; fits Bianco's 'leading pharma' thesis.

#### Reasoning

Guests set Lilly apart from peers that face patent expiries, calling it the growth leader. Cited strategist Bianco (Deutsche AM) likes leading pharma with strong pipelines. The guests warn that big short-term gains make the stock more sensitive, and that Democratic pressure on drug prices could weigh on it.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a renewed US drug-pricing push gains traction
- if growth slows after the sharp run-up

> *"Lilly är ju den lysande stjärnan"*

---

### 🟡 NIBE-B — Nibe | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Nordea cuts Nibe from buy to hold (cited analyst).

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst action only (Nordea downgrade to hold); no rationale given in the episode.

#### Sell Triggers

- if further downgrades follow

> *"Nordea sänker den pressade småspararfavoriten Nibe från köp till behåll."*

---

### 🟡 CLAS-B — Clas Ohlson | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Handelsbanken withdraws its buy recommendation and moves to hold (cited analyst).

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst action only (Handelsbanken downgrade to hold); no rationale given in the episode.

#### Sell Triggers

- if further downgrades follow

> *"Handelsbanken drar tillbaka sin köpreklamation på Clas Ohlson till behåll."*

---

### ⛔ MRNA — Moderna | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Crowded name whose valuation prices in many successes.

#### Reasoning

Guest uses Moderna as an example of crowding: a wild share-price run where today's valuation already counts many successes, which leaves the stock open to sharp reversals as hedge funds cut gross exposure.

#### Sell Triggers

- if clinical results justify the priced-in successes

> *"Moderna som har haft en extremt sjuk kursutveckling där man räknar in väldigt många succéer i dagens värdering."*

---

### ⛔ BINV — BioInvent | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Single-arm early study; Genmab's phase 3 data reduces the commercial value of its ovarian cancer project; collapse after the share issue.

#### Reasoning

Guest (Ulrika) says the fall has a fundamental basis: the company is early-stage with a single-arm study and is short of capital like other Swedish biotechs, and Genmab's strong phase 3 data in the same indication weakens the commercial case. She also asks why major shareholders did not join the issue.

#### Sell Triggers

- if new randomized data show differentiation versus Genmab
- if major shareholders step in with capital

> *"verkligheten sprungit ikapp och sprungit om"*

---

### 🟠 TNGX — Tango Therapeutics | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Named as interesting in the same space as Revolution Medicines; to be revisited.

#### Reasoning

Guest mentions it, together with Ideaya and Erasca, as working on combinations or other mechanisms in the same oncology area as Revolution Medicines; no detailed thesis given.

#### Sell Triggers

- if clinical data disappoint

> *"Sen finns det en rad andra bolag, som Tango, Idea och Erasca"*
